	}

		trigger = { DA_RX_lz = yes has_province_modifier = DA_RX_lz_flooded }
	}

		localisation_key = DA_RX_status_lz_water
		trigger = { DA_RX_lz_water = yes owner = { NOT = { OR = { has_country_modifier = DA_LZ_trait_gills has_country_modifier = DA_LZ_trait_gills_echo has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.LZ_Ars2 } } } }
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_RX_status_lz_done
		trigger = { DA_RX_lz_full = yes }
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_RX_status_lz_others
		trigger = { DA_RX_lz = yes }
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_RX_status_out
		trigger = { has_province_flag = DA_RX_out }
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_RX_status_done
		trigger = { OR = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 6 } AND = { NOT = { DA_RX_deep = yes } check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } } } }
	}
	text = {
		localisation_key = DA_RX_status_others
		trigger = { always = yes }
	}
}
